authorityDecision.text: The statutory forms prescribed by Louisiana C.Cr.P. arts. 987 through 995 and 998 are treated uniformly as COMPOSE_FROM_AUTHORITY. Generate them faithfully from the current codified article text. Existing PDF renderings of neighbouring articles are references, not a different product class. Do not wait for separate agency-issued fillable PDFs.
authorityDecision.scopeNote: The decision names arts. 987-995 and 998 by number and states the principle that neighbouring-article PDF renderings are references rather than a different product class. Families keyed to arts. 976, 977, 978 and 985 are applied under that stated principle rather than under the numbered range; that reading is recorded here rather than assumed silently.

authorityGrantDiscrepancy.whereItIsNamed: the determination's own operative text names it by number: 'The statutory forms prescribed by Louisiana C.Cr.P. arts. 987 through 995 and 998 are treated uniformly as COMPOSE_FROM_AUTHORITY. Generate them faithfully from the current codified article text.'
authorityGrantDiscrepancy.alsoOmittedBy: MASTER_QUEUE.json for this family lists forms, sourceIds and sourceReadiness.satisfiedByAuthority of 988, 991 and 992 only, while its own sourceHashes bind the Article 998 text.
authorityGrantDiscrepancy.howThisBuildTreatedIt: It composed the Article 998 motion under the determination's numbered range rather than under this family's own summary of it, asserted both halves at build time so neither can drift silently, and recorded the reading here and in build-findings.json rather than assuming it.
